υακινθινοσ.def: from ὑάκινθος (G5192); "hyacinthine" or "jacinthine", i.e. deep blue. KJV: jacinth.

υακινθοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; the "hyacinth" or "jacinth", i.e. some gem of a deep blue color, probably the zirkon. KJV: jacinth.

υαλινοσ.def: from ὕαλος (G5194); glassy, i.e. transparent. KJV: of glass.

υαλοσ.def: perhaps from the same as ὑετός (G5205) (as being transparent like rain); glass. KJV: glass.

υβριζω.def: from ὕβρις (G5196); to exercise violence, i.e. abuse. KJV: use despitefully, reproach, entreat shamefully (spitefully).

υβρισ.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228); insolence (as over-bearing), i.e. insult, injury. KJV: harm, hurt, reproach.

υβριστησ.def: from ὑβρίζω (G5195); an insulter, i.e. maltreater. KJV: despiteful, injurious.

υγιαινω.def: from ὑγιής (G5199); to have sound health, i.e. be well (in body); figuratively, to be uncorrupt (true in doctrine). KJV: be in health, (be safe and) sound, (be) whole(-some).

υγιησ.def: from the base of αὐξάνω (G837); healthy, i.e. well (in body); figuratively, true (in doctrine). KJV: sound, whole.

υγροσ.def: from the base of ὑετός (G5205); wet (as if with rain), i.e. (by implication) sappy (fresh). KJV: green.

υδρια.def: from ὕδωρ (G5204); a water-jar, i.e. receptacle for family supply. KJV: water-pot.

υδροποτεω.def: from a compound of ὕδωρ (G5204) and a derivative of πίνω (G4095); to be a water-drinker, i.e. to abstain from vinous beverages. KJV: drink water.

υδρωπικοσ.def: from a compound of ὕδωρ (G5204) and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700) (as if looking watery); to be "dropsical". KJV: have the dropsy.

υδωρ.def: from the base of ὑετός (G5205); water (as if rainy) literally or figuratively. KJV: water.

υετοσ.def: from a primary ὕω (to rain); rain, especially a shower. KJV: rain.

υιοθεσια.def: from a presumed compound of υἱός (G5207) and a derivative of τίθημι (G5087); the placing as a son, i.e. adoption (figuratively, Christian sonship in respect to God). KJV: adoption (of children, of sons).

υιοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a "son" (sometimes of animals), used very widely of immediate, remote or figuratively, kinship. KJV: child, foal, son.

υλη.def: perhaps akin to ξύλον (G3586); a forest, i.e. (by implication) fuel. KJV: matter.

υμασ.def: accusative case of ὑμεῖς (G5210); you (as the objective of a verb or preposition). KJV: ye, you (+ -ward), your (+ own).

υμεισ.def: irregular plural of σύ (G4771); you (as subjective of verb). KJV: ye (yourselves), you.

υμεναιοσ.def: from Ὑμήν (the god of weddings); "hymenæal"; Hymenæus, an opponent of Christianity. KJV: Hymenæus.

υμετεροσ.def: from ὑμεῖς (G5210); yours, i.e. pertaining to you. KJV: your (own).

υμιν.def: irregular dative case of ὑμεῖς (G5210); to (with or by) you. KJV: ye, you, your(-selves).

υμνεω.def: from ὕμνος (G5215); to hymn, i.e. sing a religious ode; by implication, to celebrate (God) in song. KJV: sing a hymn (praise unto).

υμνοσ.def: apparently from a simpler (obsolete) form of ὑδέω (to celebrate; probably akin to ᾄδω (G103); compare H5667); a "hymn" or religious ode (one of the Psalms). KJV: hymn.

υμων.def: genitive case of ὑμεῖς (G5210); of (from or concerning) you. KJV: ye, you, your (own, -selves).

υπαγω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and ἄγω (G71); to lead (oneself) under, i.e. withdraw or retire (as if sinking out of sight), literally or figuratively. KJV: depart, get hence, go (a-)way.

υπακοη.def: from ὑπακούω (G5219); attentive hearkening, i.e. (by implication) compliance or submission. KJV: obedience, (make) obedient, obey(-ing).

υπακουω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and ἀκούω (G191); to hear under (as a subordinate), i.e. to listen attentively; by implication, to heed or conform to a command or authority. KJV: hearken, be obedient to, obey.

υπανδροσ.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and ἀνήρ (G435); in subjection under a man, i.e. a married woman. KJV: which hath an husband.

υπανταω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and a derivative of ἀντί (G473); to go opposite (meet) under (quietly), i.e. to encounter, fall in with. KJV: (go to) meet.

υπαντησισ.def: from ὑπαντάω (G5221); an encounter or concurrence (with εἰς (G1519) for infinitive, in order to fall in with). KJV: meeting.

υπαρξισ.def: from ὑπάρχω (G5225); existency or proprietorship, i.e. (concretely) property, wealth. KJV: goods, substance.

υπαρχοντα.def: neuter plural of present participle active of ὑπάρχω (G5225) as noun; things extant or in hand, i.e. property or possessions. KJV: goods, that which one has, things which (one) possesseth, substance, that hast.

υπαρχω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and ἄρχομαι (G756); to begin under (quietly), i.e. come into existence (be present or at hand); expletively, to exist (as copula or subordinate to an adjective, participle, adverb or preposition, or as an auxiliary to a principal (verb). KJV: after, behave, live.

υπεικω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and εἴκω (to yield, be "weak"); to surrender. KJV: submit self.

υπεναντιοσ.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and ἐναντίος (G1727); under (covertly) contrary to, i.e. opposed or (as noun) an opponent. KJV: adversary, against.

υπερ.def: a primary preposition; "over", i.e. (with the genitive case) of place, above, beyond, across, or causal, for the sake of, instead, regarding; with the accusative case superior to, more than. KJV: (+ exceeding, abundantly) above, in (on) behalf of, beyond, by, + very chiefest, concerning, exceeding (above, -ly), for, + very highly, more (than), of, over, on the part of, for sake of, in stead, than, to(-ward), very.

υπεραιρομαι.def: middle voice from ὑπέρ (G5228) and αἴρω (G142); to raise oneself over, i.e. (figuratively) to become haughty. KJV: exalt self, be exalted above measure.

υπερακμοσ.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and the base of ἀκμήν (G188); beyond the "acme", i.e. figuratively (of a daughter) past the bloom (prime) of youth. KJV: + pass the flower of (her) age.

υπερανω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and ἄνω (G507); above upward, i.e. greatly higher (in place or rank). KJV: far above, over.

υπεραυξανω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and αὐξάνω (G837); to increase above ordinary degree. KJV: grow exceedingly.

υπερβαινω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and the base of βάσις (G939); to transcend, i.e. (figuratively) to overreach. KJV: go beyond.

υπερβαλλοντωσ.def: adverb from present participle active of ὑπερβάλλω (G5235); excessively. KJV: beyond measure.

υπερβαλλω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and βάλλω (G906); to throw beyod the usual mark, i.e. (figuratively) to surpass (only active participle supereminent). KJV: exceeding, excel, pass.

υπερβολη.def: from ὑπερβάλλω (G5235); a throwing beyond others, i.e. (figuratively) supereminence; adverbially (with εἰς (G1519) or κατά (G2596)) pre- eminently. KJV: abundance, (far more) exceeding, excellency, more excellent, beyond (out of) measure.

υπερειδω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and εἴδω (G1492); to overlook, i.e. not punish. KJV: wink at.

υπερεκεινα.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and the neuter plural of ἐκεῖνος (G1565); above those parts, i.e. still farther. KJV: beyond.

υπερεκτεινω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and ἐκτείνω (G1614); to extend inordinately. KJV: stretch beyond.

υπερεκχυνω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and the alternate form of ἐκχέω (G1632); to pour out over, i.e. (passively) to overflow. KJV: run over.

υπερεντυγχανω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and ἐντυγχάνω (G1793); to intercede in behalf of. KJV: make intercession for.

υπερεχω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold oneself above, i.e. (figuratively) to excel; participle (as adjective, or neuter as noun) superior, superiority. KJV: better, excellency, higher, pass, supreme.

υπερηφανοσ.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and φαίνω (G5316); appearing above others (conspicuous), i.e. (figuratively) haughty. KJV: proud.

υπερνικαω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and νικάω (G3528); to vanquish beyond, i.e. gain a decisive victory. KJV: more than conquer.

υπερογκοσ.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and ὄγκος (G3591); bulging over, i.e. (figuratively) insolent. KJV: great swelling.

υπεροχη.def: from ὑπερέχω (G5242); prominence, i.e. (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character). KJV: authority, excellency.

υπερπερισσευω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and περισσεύω (G4052); to super-abound. KJV: abound much more, exceeding.

υπερπερισσωσ.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and περισσῶς (G4057); superabundantly, i.e. exceedingly. KJV: beyond measure.

υπερπλεοναζω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and πλεονάζω (G4121); to superabound. KJV: be exceeding abundant.

υπερυψοω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and ὑψόω (G5312); to elevate above others, i.e. raise to the highest position. KJV: highly exalt.

υπερφρονεω.def: from ὑπέρ (G5228) and φρονέω (G5426); to esteem oneself overmuch, i.e. be vain or arrogant. KJV: think more highly.

υπερωον.def: neuter of a derivative of ὑπέρ (G5228); a higher part of the house, i.e. apartment in the third story. KJV: upper chamber (room).

υπεχω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold oneself under, i.e. endure with patience. KJV: suffer.

υπηκοοσ.def: from ὑπακούω (G5219); attentively listening, i.e. (by implication) submissive. KJV: obedient.

υπηρετεω.def: from ὑπηρέτης (G5257); to be a subordinate, i.e. (by implication) subserve. KJV: minister (unto), serve.

υπηρετησ.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and a derivative of ἐρέσσω (to row); an under-oarsman, i.e. (generally) subordinate (assistant, sexton, constable). KJV: minister, officer, servant.

υπνοσ.def: from an obsolete primary (perhaps akin to ὑπό (G5259) through the idea of subsilience); sleep, i.e. (figuratively) spiritual torpor. KJV: sleep.

υπο.def: a primary preposition; under, i.e. (with the genitive case) of place (beneath), or with verbs (the agency or means, through); (with the accusative case) of place (whither (underneath) or where (below) or time (when (at)). KJV: among, by, from, in, of, under, with.

υποβαλλω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and βάλλω (G906); to throw in stealthily, i.e. introduce by collusion. KJV: suborn.

υπογραμμοσ.def: from a compound of ὑπό (G5259) and γράφω (G1125); an underwriting, i.e. copy for imitation (figuratively). KJV: example.

υποδειγμα.def: from ὑποδείκνυμι (G5263); an exhibit for imitation or warning (figuratively, specimen, adumbration). KJV: en-(ex-)ample, pattern.

υποδεικνυμι.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and δεικνύω (G1166); to exhibit under the eyes, i.e. (figuratively) to exemplify (instruct, admonish). KJV: show, (fore-)warn.

υποδεχομαι.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and δέχομαι (G1209); to admit under one's roof, i.e. entertain hospitably. KJV: receive.

υποδεω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and δέω (G1210); to bind under one's feet, i.e. put on shoes or sandals. KJV: bind on, (be) shod.

υποδημα.def: from ὑποδέω (G5265); something bound under the feet, i.e. a shoe or sandal. KJV: shoe.

υποδικοσ.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and δίκη (G1349); under sentence, i.e. (by implication) condemned. KJV: guilty.

υποζυγιον.def: neuter of a compound of ὑπό (G5259) and ζυγός (G2218); an animal under the yoke (draught-beast), i.e. (specially), a donkey. KJV: ass.

υποζωννυμι.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and ζώννυμι (G2224); to gird under, i.e. frap (a vessel with cables across the keel, sides and deck). KJV: undergirt.

υποκατω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and κάτω (G2736); down under, i.e. beneath. KJV: under.

υποκρινομαι.def: middle voice from ὑπό (G5259) and κρίνω (G2919); to decide (speak or act) under a false part, i.e. (figuratively) dissemble (pretend). KJV: feign.

υποκρισισ.def: from ὑποκρίνομαι (G5271); acting under a feigned part, i.e. (figuratively) deceit ("hypocrisy"). KJV: condemnation, dissimulation, hypocrisy.

υποκριτησ.def: from ὑποκρίνομαι (G5271); an actor under an assumed character (stage-player), i.e. (figuratively) a dissembler ("hypocrite". KJV: hypocrite.

υπολαμβανω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to take from below, i.e. carry upward; figuratively, to take up, i.e. continue a discourse or topic; mentally, to assume (presume). KJV: answer, receive, suppose.

υπολειπω.def: from ὑποτρέχω (G5295) and λείπω (G3007); to leave under (behind), i.e. (passively) to remain (survive). KJV: be left.

υποληνιον.def: neuter of a presumed compound of ὑπό (G5259) and ληνός (G3025); vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e. lower wine-vat. KJV: winefat.

υπολιμπανω.def: a prolonged form for ὑπολείπω (G5275); to leave behind, i.e. bequeath. KJV: leave.

υπομενω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and μένω (G3306); to stay under (behind), i.e. remain; figuratively, to undergo, i.e. bear (trials), have fortitude, persevere. KJV: abide, endure, (take) patient(-ly), suffer, tarry behind.

υπομιμνησκω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and μιμνήσκω (G3403); to remind quietly, i.e. suggest to the (middle voice, one's own) memory. KJV: put in mind, remember, bring to (put in) remembrance.

υπομνησισ.def: from ὑπομιμνήσκω (G5279); a reminding or (reflexively) recollection. KJV: remembrance.

υπομονη.def: from ὑπομένω (G5278); cheerful (or hopeful) endurance, constancy. KJV: enduring, patience, patient continuance (waiting).

υπονοεω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and νοιέω (G3539); to think under (privately), i.e. to surmise or conjecture. KJV: think, suppose, deem.

υποπλεω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and πλέω (G4126); to sail under the lee of. KJV: sail under.

υποπνεω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and πνέω (G4154); to breathe gently, i.e. breeze. KJV: blow softly.

υποποδιον.def: neuter of a compound of ὑπό (G5259) and πούς (G4228); something under the feet, i.e. a foot-rest (figuratively). KJV: footstool.

υποστασισ.def: from a compound of ὑπό (G5259) and ἵστημι (G2476); a setting under (support), i.e. (figuratively) concretely, essence, or abstractly, assurance (objectively or subjectively). KJV: confidence, confident, person, substance.

υποστελλω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and στέλλω (G4724); to withhold under (out of sight), i.e. (reflexively) to cower or shrink, (figuratively) to conceal (reserve). KJV: draw (keep) back, shun, withdraw.

υποστολη.def: from ὑποστέλλω (G5288); shrinkage (timidity), i.e. (by implication) apostasy. KJV: draw back.

υποστρεφω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and στρέφω (G4762); to turn under (behind), i.e. to return (literally or figuratively). KJV: come again, return (again, back again), turn back (again).

υποστρωννυμι.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and στρώννυμι (G4766); to strew underneath (the feet as a carpet). KJV: spread.

υποτασσω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and τάσσω (G5021); to subordinate; reflexively, to obey. KJV: be under obedience (obedient), put under, subdue unto, (be, make) subject (to, unto), be (put) in subjection (to, under), submit self unto.

υποτιθημι.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and τίθημι (G5087); to place underneath, i.e. (figuratively) to hazard, (reflexively) to suggest. KJV: lay down, put in remembrance.

υποτρεχω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and τρέχω (G5143) (including its alternate); to run under, i.e. (specially), to sail past. KJV: run under.

υποτυπωσισ.def: from a compound of ὑπό (G5259) and a derivative of τύπος (G5179); typification under (after), i.e. (concretely) a sketch (figuratively) for imitation. KJV: form, pattern.

υποφερω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and φέρω (G5342); to bear from underneath, i.e. (figuratively) to undergo hardship. KJV: bear, endure.

υποχωρεω.def: from ὑπό (G5259) and χωρέω (G5562); to vacate down, i.e. retire quietly. KJV: go aside, withdraw self.

υπωπιαζω.def: from a compound of ὑπό (G5259) and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); to hit under the eye (buffet or disable an antagonist as a pugilist), i.e. (figuratively) to tease or annoy (into compliance), subdue (one's passions). KJV: keep under, weary.

υσ.def: apparently a primary word; a hog ("swine"). KJV: sow.

υστερεω.def: from ὕστερος (G5306); to be later, i.e. (by implication) to be inferior; generally, to fall short (be deficient). KJV: come behind (short), be destitute, fail, lack, suffer need, (be in) want, be the worse.

υστερημα.def: from ὑστερέω (G5302); a deficit; specially, poverty. KJV: that which is behind, (that which was) lack(-ing), penury, want.

υστερησισ.def: from ὑστερέω (G5302); a falling short, i.e. (specially), penury. KJV: want.

υστερον.def: neuter of ὕστερος (G5306) as adverb; more lately, i.e. eventually. KJV: afterward, (at the) last (of all).

υστεροσ.def: comparative from ὑπό (G5259) (in the sense of behind); later. KJV: latter.

υφαντοσ.def: from ὑφαίνω to weave; woven, i.e. (perhaps) knitted. KJV: woven.

υψηλοσ.def: from ὕψος (G5311); lofty (in place or character). KJV: high(-er, -ly) (esteemed).

υψηλοφρονεω.def: from a compound of ὑψηλός (G5308) and φρήν (G5424); to be lofty in mind, i.e. arrogant. KJV: be highminded.

υψιστοσ.def: superlative from the base of ὕψος (G5311); highest, i.e. (masculine singular) the Supreme (God), or (neuter plural) the heavens. KJV: most high, highest.

υψοσ.def: from a derivative of ὑπέρ (G5228); elevation, i.e. (abstractly) altitude, (specially), the sky, or (figuratively) dignity. KJV: be exalted, height, (on) high.

υψοω.def: from ὕψος (G5311); to elevate (literally or figuratively). KJV: exalt, lift up.

υψωμα.def: from ὑψόω (G5312); an elevated place or thing, i.e. (abstractly) altitude, or (by implication) a barrier (figuratively). KJV: height, high thing.
